decisions.reason: After several years on the market, this dental materials line likely shows performance close enough to aspiration and enough fit with the firm's thermoforming and laboratory workflow business to justify continued retention.

This PETG thermoforming blank is tightly aligned with the firm's established dental laboratory capabilities, and survival since launch suggests results are acceptable relative to aspirations, so it should be kept.

The intraoral contrast spray supports digital and clinical workflows but is somewhat more niche than the core custom-material lines, so it is kept while carrying a somewhat higher withdrawal risk if it underperforms aspirations.

The custom earmold line matches the firm's hearing-care customer base and custom manufacturing strengths well, and continued presence implies it is meeting aspirations sufficiently to remain in the portfolio.
